task_description: Write a method in Dafny to return the negative numbers from an integer array.
specification_response:

Postconditions_prompt:

- Every negative number in the input array is included in the output array
- The order of elements in the output array corresponds to their order in the input array
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method FindNegativeNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.

Natural language description:

Dafny specification:

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The output sequence contains exactly the negative numbers from the input array
    - The order of negative numbers in the output matches their order in the input array
    - All elements in the output are negative
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[i]) && negatives[i] in arr[..]
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && arr[i] < 0 ==> arr[i] in negatives
    ensures |negatives| == countNegatives(arr)
    
Define auxiliary predicate:
predicate IsNegative(n: int)
{
    n < 0
}

Define auxiliary function:
function countNegatives(arr: array<int>): nat
{
    if arr.Length == 0 then 0
    else (if arr[arr.Length - 1] < 0 then 1 else 0) + countNegatives(arr[..arr.Length - 1])
}

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
predicate IsNegative(n: int)
{
    n < 0
}

method FindNegativeNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)
    requires arr != null
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[i]) && negatives[i] in arr[..]
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && arr[i] < 0 ==> arr[i] in negatives
    ensures |negatives| == countNegatives(arr)
{
    negatives := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < arr.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= arr.Length
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[k]) && negatives[k] in arr[..]
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i && arr[k] < 0 ==> arr[k] in negatives
        invariant |negatives| == countNegatives(arr[..i])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> arr[k] != 0
    {
        if arr[i] < 0
        {
            negatives := negatives + [arr[i]];
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
